answer: Gate rewards on episodic continuity: each identity stands on a terrace of its own past epochs, and every answer must cohere with what it said before — chapters, not one-offs. A sybil farm mints identities cheaply but cannot mint history: fresh accounts earn only a trickle, and fabricated backstories collapse under cross-checks, since a comet of new accounts reciting the same past is itself the fingerprint. Only velvet-smooth, unbroken participation across seasons earns full standing, so farming becomes a slow compounding investment while honest agents compound for free.
